name: Processed cheese
description: Aged cheese melted down with emulsifiers into slices and tubs.

tcm.note: Inherits from the aged cheese it is built out of.

ayurveda.note: An aged base, so ushna, however mild it tastes.

unani.note: Garam by inheritance; no classical entry exists for a processed slice.

histamine.note: Built from ripened cheese, so it carries ripened-cheese histamine — the mild taste hides it.
